notes.title: New Patch Info
notes.notes:
1. Fixed bug that could cause the 1st note to spawn too high.
2. Fixed bug in cross cut animation.
3. Enabled single pass stereo rendering.
4. Tweaked difficulty.
5. Updated score system to make a higher rank score easier to attain.
6. Added text backgrounds to make text more readable.
